pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: high error rate (502/504/503) from gateway in us-east-1 (alerts: gateway-5xx-spike). Threshold breached at 01:07 UTC.

alice.h: I'm on it, grabbing logs and traces. Paging @sre-oncall and @devon_ops.

sre-oncall: ack. Quick check: is this an ingress spike or egress? Any obvious deploys?

alice.h: no deploys in last hour per deploy-bot. Initial dashboards show increased 5xx from /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints, overall latency rising ~300ms -> 2s.

ben.j: seeing amplification in gateway logs: client retries combined with upstream retry policy -> lots of duplicate inflight. Sample from proxy: `x-request-id=cid:abc123:retry=2 upstream_status=504 host=model-service`

carla_m: can you paste a full kvlog for a correlation ID? Need to build a timeline.

alice.h: pasting sanitized trace snippet: ```
CID=cid:abc123
00:00:00 - request ingress at gateway node gw-03
00:00:120 - gateway forwarded to router-pool A => upstream model-serve-01 (timeout)
00:00:250 - gateway retried route => router-pool B => model-serve-03 (503)
00:01:000 - client retry observed (client_id=mobile-frontend v12) => additional inbound attempt
```

devon_ops: hypothesis 1: upstream model-serving hosts are overloaded, gateway retry policy is amplifying load -> cascading timeouts.

alice.h: hypothesis 2: an internal load-balancer started returning 502 for a subset of shards after healthcheck flapping. See NGINX error `upstream prematurely closed connection` repeating.

infra-bot: Note: autoscaler triggered scale-up for model-pool B at 01:08:20 UTC, pending new nodes.

sre-oncall: customer-impact check: preliminary metric shows ~18% of requests in last 10m failing with 5xx, traffic mostly from interactive chat (PLG tier). Sending status to #general-incidents.

carla_m: sharing grep of logs for cid:abc123 across proxies and routers: ```
2026-02-14T01:07:02Z gw-03 INFO request cid=abc123 route=/v1/chat forwarded=router-A
2026-02-14T01:07:05Z router-A WARN upstream=model-serve-01 status=timeout rt=120.3ms
2026-02-14T01:07:05Z gw-03 INFO retrying cid=abc123 retry=1
2026-02-14T01:07:07Z router-B INFO upstream=model-serve-03 status=503 rt=250.7ms
2026-02-14T01:07:08Z gw-03 INFO respond status=504 to client cid=abc123
```

ben.j: also pulled egress metrics to model-serve pool: error rate jumped at 01:06:50, p95 compute time unchanged, queue depth spiked. Looks like queue backlog then retries.

alice.h: mitigation options: a) temporarily reduce gateway retry attempts to 0 for chat endpoints, b) enable fallback to smaller model variant (quantized) for new requests, c) increase per-pool headroom. Any objections?

devon_ops: do (a) immediately, (b) if (a) doesn't resolve in 3m. We need to stop amplification first.

sre-oncall: performing (a) now: applying runtime config change to gateway retry policy -> `max_retries=0` for /v1/chat and /v1/generate (rolling patch). Will post when done.

infra-bot: change applied on gw-01..gw-04 at 01:09:12 UTC.

alice.h: monitoring... error rate dipped to 9% within 90s. Latency back toward baseline but still elevated.

carla_m: starting timeline builder doc, adding sample KV logs and correlation ids. Attaching list of 25 representative cids for sampling: [cid:abc123, cid:def456, cid:ghi789, cid:jkl012, ...]

ben.j: while retry policy change helped, we still have ~6% errors. I'm seeing persistent 503s from model-serve-03 group; likely degraded host(s). Can we cordon model-serve-03 and drain?

devon_ops: initiating drain of model-serve-03 hosts. Triggering immediate rebalancing and removing unhealthy targets from LB pool.

infra-bot: host model-serve-03-7 marked Unhealthy by healthcheck at 01:10:43 UTC, removal in progress.

sre-oncall: customer comms: low-severity degradation, ~10-20% failures for interactive requests for ~10 minutes, mitigations in progress. Posting initial update to status page.

alice.h: collecting stack traces and recent deploy logs for model-serve-03. No deploys. Found OOM events in kernel logs on two hosts around 01:06:45. Possibly memory pressure on that pool.

carla_m: hypothesis 3: a memory leak in model runtime caused hosts to become unresponsive -> healthchecks fail -> LB retries -> gateway amplifies. We should check process RSS trends.

ben.j: pulled `ps` snapshots, see model-infer process RSS growth: 6GB -> 12GB in 30m on affected hosts. That matches OOM events.

devon_ops: mitigation: rolling kill-and-restart for affected model-infer processes + adjust oom_score_adj to reduce killing important services. Also scale up replicas to absorb traffic.

alice.h: performing rolling restart of model-serve-03 replica set now (graceful drain). ETA ~6m.

infra-bot: restart step started at 01:12:20 UTC.

sre-oncall: monitoring customer impact; will keep status updated. If restarts don't fix in 10m consider fallback routing to quantized model.

carla_m: building RCA timeline so far: 
- 01:06:40 UTC: memory growth on model-infer in pool 03 crosses threshold -> kernel OOMs start 
- 01:06:50 UTC: healthchecks fail for subset of hosts -> LB marks unhealthy 
- 01:07:00 UTC: gateway receives initial timeouts -> gateway retry policy amplifies attempts 
- 01:07:30 UTC: increased load + retries cause more queueing -> 5xx surge visible to customers 
- 01:09:12 UTC: retry policy reduced to 0 -> error amplification reduced 
- 01:12:20 UTC: rolling restart begins -> targeted hosts removed from rotation

ben.j: after restart, error rate normalized to ~1.2% by 01:18 UTC. p95 latency back to baseline.

alice.h: post-mortem action items (quick list): 
- (P0) Immediate: add a runtime guard to prevent unbounded RSS growth and enable early restart if RSS>10GB for 2m.
- (P1) infra: review LB and gateway retry configs to ensure retries cannot amplify during partial backend failures.
- (P2) oncall playbook: add step to reduce gateway retries earlier in timeline.
- (P3) ops: add better memory metrics and alert for model-infer processes.

devon_ops: I've created follow-ups in the incident board and assigned owners.

carla_m: saving collected kvlogs and correlation id list to the incident bundle: `s3://redwood-incident-bundles/1755002468/` (access controlled).

alice.h: final note for the thread: root cause appears to be memory growth in model runtime causing LB failures; gateway retry policy amplified the customer impact. Mitigations: retry policy change + rolling restarts resolved the spike. Will start a formal RCA doc tomorrow with full timelines and graphs.

sre-oncall: closing paging loop. If anyone wants to add logs or a different hypothesis, append here before I convert to postmortem. :white_check_mark:

ben.j: adding link to perf graphs and heap profiles in #eng-runtime.``
